scripts.build: npm run build:lambda && npm run build:frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd infra && terraform apply
scripts.deploy:sync: bash -c "aws s3 sync frontend/dist/ s3://$(cd infra && terraform output -raw frontend_bucket_name) --delete"
scripts.deploy:invalidate: bash -c "aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(cd infra && terraform output -raw cloudfront_distribution_id) --paths '/*'"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
